chapter.title: Devices of a VM
chapter.para: A VM has no devices but those that this chapter lists. An access to any other device does not reach the hardware.

section.para: On x86_64 the hypervisor shall give the guest the I/O ports of its devices only: the 8259A pair (0x20-0x21, 0xA0-0xA1), the 8254 timer and port B (0x40-0x43, 0x61), the console port (COM1) and the GDB port (COM2) of the VM, and the keyboard controller (0x60, 0x64) and reset control (0xCF9) ports, through which the guest resets the VM.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A guest must not drive a device that is not its own.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_IOPORT_IO_INIT_IOPM_01 HLR_IOPORT_IN_RANGE_01 HLR_IOPORT_IO_ACCESS_01 HLR_MULTIBOOT_HV_ARCH_VM_INIT_01 HLR_SVM_IO_MASK_01 HLR_SVM_HANDLE_IO_01

section.para: On x86_64 the hypervisor shall make any other I/O port read as all ones and ignore writes to it, the first access to each being reported on the console of the hypervisor, except for the ports 0x80, 0xED and 0xCF8-0xCFF, which are silent.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A guest that probes for a device must find none, and the operator must see what it looked for.

section.para: On x86_64 the hypervisor shall give the VM no local APIC, I/O APIC or PCI device.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: JetOS for x86_64 works with the legacy devices alone; the partitions that need PCI devices do not run in a VM.

section.para: On arm64 the hypervisor shall give the VM the devices of the QEMU virt machine that JetOS uses and no others: the GICv2 (the distributor emulated, the CPU interface direct), the PL011 of the console (0x09000000), the PL031 real-time clock (0x09010000) and, if the VM has a GDB port, a second PL011 (0x09040000) that is listed in the device tree of the VM.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: These are the devices that the JetOS board support package for arm64 uses.

section.para: On arm64 the hypervisor shall emulate an access of a guest to an emulated device that it can decode (an instruction that gives its syndrome).

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: An instruction that cannot be decoded cannot be repeated for the guest.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_MMIO_DEVICE_OF_01 HLR_MMIO_EMULATE_01 HLR_MMIO_LOAD_VALUE_01 HLR_MMIO_MMIO_ABORT_01 HLR_VGICD_VGICD_ACCESS_01 HLR_VUART_ARM64_VUART_ACCESS_02 HLR_VUART_VRTC_ACCESS_02

section.para: On arm64 the hypervisor shall make a register of an emulated device that it does not emulate read as zero and ignore writes to it, the first access to each being reported.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A guest that probes a register must find nothing there, and the operator must see what it looked for.

formalpara.title: Traceability
formalpara.para: HLR_MMIO_LOG_UNHANDLED_01 HLR_MMIO_EMULATE_01 HLR_MMIO_EMULATE_02 HLR_VUART_ARM64_VUART_ACCESS_02 HLR_VUART_ARM64_VUART_ACCESS_03 HLR_VUART_VRTC_ACCESS_02 HLR_VUART_VRTC_ACCESS_03

section.para: On arm64 the hypervisor shall stop the VM for an access to an emulated device that it cannot decode.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: An instruction that cannot be decoded cannot be repeated for the guest.

section.para: On arm64 the hypervisor shall answer the power state calls (PSCI) that a guest makes with the hypervisor call or the secure monitor call, for a VM that has one CPU: the version, the features, the affinity information, the starting and the switching off of a CPU, and the switching off and the reset of the VM.

formalpara.title: Rationale
formalpara.para: A guest reboots and stops itself through PSCI.
